error.title: Error page!

http.403: You are not authorized to access this page.
http.405: The HTTP verb you used is not supported for this URL.
http.503: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

error.concurrencyFailure: Another user modified this data at the same time as you. Your changes were rejected.

patientService.refused: This cannot be shown to you: your role is not permitted to read the patient records this page is built from. Nothing is broken and trying again will not help — speak to your administrator if you believe you should have access.
patientService.unreachable: The patient records service is not answering just now, so this page could not be filled. Nothing you did caused it. Please try again in a few minutes, and tell your administrator if it keeps happening.
